C0179.title: Hangzhou Xiaoshan Online Pharmaceutical Wholesaler Price Gouging Case
C0179.summary: In January 2023, the Xiaoshan District Market Supervision Administration in Hangzhou disclosed a typical epidemic-related drug pricing violation. A Zhejiang pharmaceutical company sharply raised the selling price of Yinqiao Jiedu capsules despite no clear increase in procurement costs. Its Yinqiao Jiedu granules were already sold out and suppliers had not supplied goods or announced price increases, yet the company repeatedly raised the online listed price to 22 yuan, creating a misleading high-price display without reasonable basis. Regulators found illegal price gouging and imposed confiscation of illegal gains plus a 120,000 yuan fine.
